covers: Overall shape of the Next.js app: App Router layout, top-level directories, request lifecycle.

stack.framework: Next.js 15.1.6, App Router (src/app/), Turbopack for dev
stack.package_manager: pnpm (pnpm-workspace.yaml; part of a 2-repo pnpm workspace alongside 'E-SIM backend')
stack.language: TypeScript, strict mode, path alias @/* -> src/*

top_level_dirs.src/app: routes (App Router) + colocated client components + route handlers under app/bff/**
top_level_dirs.src/lib: cross-cutting server/shared helpers: backend client, session/cookies, route guard, public origin, seo
top_level_dirs.src/services: data-shaping layer between backend payloads and UI models (packages.ts client-side, server-packages.ts server-side)
top_level_dirs.src/content: static typed content for landing/legal/SEO pages
top_level_dirs.docs/sessions: dated session logs, see docs/sessions/INDEX.md for the full list — primary source for 'why', do not duplicate into feedAI, link to it
top_level_dirs.docs/superpowers/specs: design specs (e.g. web profile/account area spec)

request_flow.public_page: Server Component reads data via src/services/server-packages.ts -> backendFetch() directly to backend origin (no cookie needed for public catalog)
request_flow.authenticated_browser_call: Client Component fetch('/bff/<path>') -> Next route handler in src/app/bff/** -> callWithSession()/backendFetch() -> backend, with httpOnly cookies read/written by the route handler
request_flow.middleware: src/middleware.ts runs on every non-static request: canonical-host/https/trailing-slash redirects first, then auth route guard (src/lib/route-guard.ts)

not_yet_answered: No package-level README/ARCHITECTURE.md exists in this repo beyond docs/sessions logs; treat those session files as the primary architecture record.
